translations.description: The complete set of names the tag should have, one per language; left out keeps the stored names. `cs` is required (400 without a non-empty one). A language that is not sent, or sent with an empty name, is removed (for `en`: no English name, the web falls back to `cs`)

name.description: Name of the tag in this language. An empty name is skipped (for `en` it means no English name, the web shows the Czech one); `cs` needs a non-empty name

version.description: The `version` of the record the change is based on (from its detail). When another one is stored, nothing is written and the answer is 409 with the code VERSION_CONFLICT. Left out, the change is written without the check
